## Architecture Overview

The `TLSClientConfig` field in `rest.Config` is a value type `rest.TLSClientConfig`. Changing to pointer `*rest.TLSClientConfig` breaks all code that assigns `config.TLSClientConfig = rest.TLSClientConfig{...}` as a value.

## Detailed Analysis

### ArgoCD

- **`pkg/apis/application/v1alpha1/types.go`** (lines 3681, 3741-3747) — `config.TLSClientConfig = rest.TLSClientConfig{}`, `tlsClientConfig := rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: ..., ServerName: ..., CertData: ..., KeyData: ..., CAData: ...}`.

### External-Secrets

- **`providers/v1/kubernetes/auth.go`** (lines 74-77, 100-101) — `cfg.TLSClientConfig = rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: false, CAData: ca}`, then `cfg.TLSClientConfig.KeyData = key`.

### Ingress-Nginx

- **`cmd/nginx/main.go`** (lines 194-202) — `tlsClientConfig := rest.TLSClientConfig{}` followed by `cfg.TLSClientConfig = tlsClientConfig`.

### Grafana

- **`pkg/services/apiserver/service.go`** (line 333) — `serverConfig.LoopbackClientConfig.TLSClientConfig = clientrest.TLSClientConfig{}`.
- **`pkg/services/authz/rbac.go`** (lines 270-273) — `TLSClientConfig: rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: ..., CAFile: ...}`.
- **`pkg/operators/provisioning/config.go`** (lines 123-125) — `tlsConfig := rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: insecure}`.
- **`pkg/operators/iam/zanzana_folder_reconciler.go`** (lines 162-164) — `tlsConfig := rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: insecure}`.
- **`pkg/registry/apis/iam/authorizer/parent_provider.go`** (lines 77-79) — `TLSClientConfig: rest.TLSClientConfig{Insecure: ..., CAFile: ...}`.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| argo-cd | pkg/apis/application/v1alpha1/types.go | Value-type TLSClientConfig assignment |
| external-secrets | providers/v1/kubernetes/auth.go | Value-type TLSClientConfig assignment |
| ingress-nginx | cmd/nginx/main.go | Value-type TLSClientConfig creation and assignment |
| grafana | pkg/services/apiserver/service.go | Empty TLSClientConfig value assignment |
| grafana | pkg/services/authz/rbac.go | TLSClientConfig value in struct literal |
| grafana | pkg/operators/provisioning/config.go | TLSClientConfig value creation |
| grafana | pkg/operators/iam/zanzana_folder_reconciler.go | TLSClientConfig value creation |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/iam/authorizer/parent_provider.go | TLSClientConfig value in struct literal |
